setup.zh: 荆鼎从龟背上升起来。鼎身上铸着江、汉、九江和云梦——荆州的一切。大龟游回湖底去了。
setup.en: The Cauldron of Jing rises from the turtle's back. Cast on its body are the Jiang, the Han, the Nine Rivers and Yunmeng — everything of Jing. The great turtle swims back down.

recap.zh: 荆鼎从大龟背上升起，铸着江、汉、九江和云梦。
recap.en: The Cauldron of Jing rose from the turtle's back, cast with the Jiang, the Han, the Nine Rivers and Yunmeng.

text.zh: 在德不在鼎——这话是她教我的。她说，谁问鼎有多重，谁就已经拿不动它了。
text.en: In virtue, not in the cauldron — she taught me that. She said whoever asks what a cauldron weighs can no longer lift it.

alone.zh: 鼎身上有一行小字，磨得快看不清了：在德不在鼎。
alone.en: On the cauldron runs a line of small characters, worn almost away: in virtue, not in the cauldron.

label.en: Take the cauldron's breath · Body Integration

exits.means: touches the cauldron, takes its breath, attempts the breakthrough

refuse.zh: 鼎气涌上来又退开。炼虚未满，合不了体。先回人间，把功课做满。
refuse.en: The breath surges over you and draws back. Your Void Refinement is not yet full; you cannot become one. Go back to the world and fill your practice first.

text.zh: 江与汉从两边涌来，在你身上汇成一条。元神与身子再分不出彼此——合体了。鼎小了，小到握在掌心，和前五口并排。
text.en: The Jiang and the Han pour in from two sides and join in you into one river. Spirit and body can no longer be told apart — Body Integration. The cauldron shrinks until it sits in your palm beside the other five.

exits.means: hesitates, asks what will happen, wants to prepare first

text.zh: 风暴刮了八十一天，它不差这一会儿。
text.en: The storm blew for eighty-one days. It can spare a while.

alone.zh: 风暴刮了八十一天。它等得起。
alone.en: The storm blew for eighty-one days. It can wait.
